After the demo release, some bugs were noticed and fixed:

notes.title: The demo version is out!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/38fdec092f29d3499c00ffd08932ca0dd1ec15cf.png[/img]

[h2]The demo version is out![/h2]

It took a little longer than I expected, but now the demo is available for download!

The average playtime of the demo is 4-5 hours, which is probably a bit more than the usual 30-minute demo. Whether that's a plus or a minus, I'm not sure, but what's done is done.

After the play-tests, some things were changed, some were removed, some were added, and all that. I'm really hoping to get more feedback from players to improve the game.

The main goal right now is a bit of marketing, after which I'll continue working on the first chapter.

You can find the demo here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3239890/Dustopia_Demo/

Thanks for reading this, and I hope you enjoy the demo!

notes.title: First wave of playtests!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/40d7d6b737e705ad44bc92faf5fe36ffc382d9a2.png[/img]

The demo version of Dystopia is almost ready! The first wave of closed playtests is currently underway, which helps identify various bugs, observe the behavior of regular players, and determine what works and what doesn't. The first wave includes family members and friends. I understand that such a selection usually has a positive bias since they know you and might overlook certain issues. Therefore, shortly after the first wave, there will be a second wave, which will include random people.

What have I noticed during the playtests?

[h3]Highlight everything[/h3]
Absolutely every object in the world that can be interacted with should stand out clearly. A variety of methods can be used: particles, highlighting, dialogue, and anything else that can attract the player's attention.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/084ff75213d6f6b13e283c3f3616895fc9d64be0.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/4df9a467e3d722720a7b3b19c4365dcc596c0fba.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/ce314f7f648895a3fefaf43f228055076bc9197e.jpg[/img]

[h3]UI improvement[/h3]
Some UI elements that are obvious to the developer can often be unclear to regular players, so work has been done on that as well.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/dddaee8a0dc3b00ec51975c429408411846be281.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/5042f03d75f518eaf70fb891ba54b9857aad0855.jpg[/img]

That's all for now. After the first wave, work on translation will begin, because the game was initially not written in English. After the translation, you will be able to participate in the second wave of playtests, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Create your own unique cards!
notes.content:
We're thrilled to announce that you can now create your own cards and deploy them in battles!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/262a9a0476819c1fa65937b0f3f9bc29a230576d.png[/img]

The card editor comprises four main tabs - Image, Tags, Misc, and Abilities.

On the Images tab, you can select the image to represent your card. You have the flexibility to choose from pre-made images or upload your own!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/41ff537b8d0636f5062bb8260b8e2e77497626c8.jpg[/img]

The Tags tab allows you to define the properties of your card. You must specify whether the card is organic or inorganic; all other tags are optional.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/2c2be4db3a6e6aa05588d539c7008708d5cfc5e4.jpg[/img]

Moving on to the Misc tab, here you can customize the card's attack animation and select sounds for various actions. We offer a range of pre-made sounds, but you can also upload your own! To enable the card to randomly select from different sounds for the same action, the sounds must share the same name but have different numbers at the end. If everything is set up correctly, you'll see the number of sounds available, from which the card will choose during the action.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/1713180ea92f15e1f6d93eef5c2b189a3f5fc8e9.jpg[/img]

The Abilities tab is where you determine your card's combat options - price, health, damage, special card, and abilities. Initially, only a limited number of abilities will be accessible, but as you progress, more will become available for use.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/3de015b820c9de4b621d68f737808401203fb3c9.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/6a57a8714934f34a475ec5b39fd18f34a1bc3da0.jpg[/img]

And of course, you can deploy your custom cards in battle!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870552/25df1bab6fd2df894f50a4d4810b90b9bab652c4.jpg[/img]
